XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Brakes

  • Device: ABS control unit

  • Fault: The vehicle’s speedometer and odometer are not functioning. The ABS, engine fault and brake fault (red) warning lights are illuminated on the instrument panel; the vehicle continues to operate normally.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • U0121 (CAN data bus, ABS control unit – Loss of communication)
  • U2197 (Invalid vehicle speed data)
  • U2200 (Airbag control unit - Programming error)
  • U0155 (CAN data bus, instrument cluster control unit - Loss of communication)
  • C1155 (Front left wheel speed sensor - Wiring/sensor)
  • C1235 (Rear right wheel speed sensor - No signal)
  • C1236 (Rear left wheel speed sensor - No signal)
  • C1233 (Front left wheel speed sensor - No signal)
  • C1934 (Hydraulic pump unit pressurisation failure)
  • Cause: ABS control unit, including hydraulic assembly, malfunctioning

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the ABS control unit, including the hydraulic assembly; replace it if necessary. Then bleed the braking system.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Problems with this component are quite common on this model.
